entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: High-level EventSource-style client for Server-Sent Events #122834
  • Build error: MSB4057: The target "CreatePkg" does not exist in the project. #122832
  • Compilation-time error, no error location output!!! Span<ulong> span = MemoryMarshal.Cast<TestStruct, ulong>(arr); #122827

Closed

  • System.Text.Json.JsonException thrown when deserializing asynchronously to nullable types #110450
    Future
  • System.IO.DriveInfo.GetDrives() random AccessViolationException on macOS #122634
  • FromBase64Transform asserts when destination buffer is too small #122807
  • FromBase64Transform incorrectly rents from CryptoPool (ArrayPool) #122804
  • Reachable assert in CertificateRevocationListBuilder.LoadPem with trailing data #122823
  • SerialPort: NullReferenceException #119156
    Future
  • Light up Utf8Utility.*.cs and Utf16Utility.*.cs with Vector512 code paths. #86119
    Future
  • NetFxToWinRtStreamAdapter.WriteAsync fails with ArgumentOutOfRangeException when buffer is empty #31564
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix System.Timers.Timer Stop() not working after setting AutoReset or Interval on disabled one-shot timer #122843
  • Fix duplicate serialization of virtual properties with JsonPropertyName on base class #122842
  • Fix JsonNode.GetPath() to properly escape characters in property names #122841
  • Fix JsonSerializer.Serialize producing invalid JSON for [JsonExtensionData] with JsonObject #122838
  • Fix ZIP64 header corruption when large file at large offset #122837
  • Verify fix for balancing group bug in Regular Expressions (#111161) #122836
  • Fix StackOverflowException serializing dictionary with string key and object-converter that handles string #122835
  • Cleanup always-on FEATURE_EH_FUNCLETS #122833
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix: Socket.SendFile throws when Blocking=false #122831
    area-System.Net.Sockets, community-contribution
  • Add missing filesystem magic numbers to UnixFileSystemTypes enum #122829
    area-System.IO
  • Fix ReadOnlySequence.Slice validation for single-segment sequences #122828
    area-System.Memory

Merged

  • Fix thread-safety issue in DriveInfo.GetDrives() on macOS by replacing getmntinfo with getfsstat #122637
  • Remove managed implementation from SP800-108 on Windows #122816
    area-System.Security
  • Fix trailing data handling with CertificateRevocationListBuilder.LoadPem. #122825
    area-System.Security
  • Fix FromBase64Transform buffer sizing and output buffer handling #122805
    area-System.Security
  • Fix NullReferenceException in SerialPort event callbacks when handler unsubscribes during invocation #122830
    area-System.IO.Ports
  • Remove use of BCryptDeriveKeyPBKDF2. #122812
    area-System.Security

Updated

  • Fix JsonSourceGenerator verbatim identifier handling in property initializers #122740
    area-System.Text.Json
  • Fix missing Dispose override in SizeOptIListSelectIterator and SizeOptIListWhereIterator #122729
    area-System.Linq
  • Improve code coverage for System.Security.Cryptography.Xml #120640
    area-System.Security, test-enhancement
  • Assume hash handles are always reusable in HashProviderCng. #122813
    area-System.Security
  • Add III.1.7 "Managed pointers exposing parameters outside of the method scope" to Ecma-335-Augments.md #122821
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix building the sanitizer instrumentation and hooking it into the hosts #116166
    area-Infrastructure, community-contribution
  • [wasm][coreclr] Do not try to probe .ni.dll assemblies #122643
    area-AssemblyLoader-coreclr, Future
  • Optimize AllocHeap: use new/delete with 4KB blocks and static allocation #122822
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix UnsafeAccessor signature for byref struct this #122754
    area-System.Runtime.CompilerServices, community-contribution
  • Update comment to use `Ascii.IsValid` in `KeyAnalyzer` #122715
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • Async instantiating and unboxing thunks #122126
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Consolidate GC.AddMemoryPressure/RemoveMemoryPressure implementation between NativeAOT and CoreCLR #122824
